articles.headline: Martin O'Neill positive on Celtic Europa League hopes despite 4-1 thrashing to Benfica
articles.description: Martin O'Neill hailed Celtic's second-half display in the 4-1 Europa League defeat by Benfica which left them with no points from six in the league phase.

images.name: Martin O'Neill [1296x729]
images.caption: Martin O'Neill remained positive despite a disappointing night in Lisbon.
images.alt: Celtic manager Martin O'Neill (L) and assistant Shaun Maloney during a UEFA Europa League 2026/27 League Phase MD2 match between SL Benfica and Celtic at Estadio da Luz, on October 15, 2026, in Lisbon, Portugal.
images.credit: Craig Williamson/SNS Group via Getty Images

articles.headline: Marco Rose: "Privilege" to lead Bournemouth after winning first-ever home European match
articles.description: Marco Rose said it was a "privilege" to lead Bournemouth to victory in their first-ever home match in Europe after Sturm Graz were beaten 3-0 at the Vitality Stadium.

images.name: Marco Rose [1296x729]
images.caption: Marco Rose was buoyed after his Bournemouth side cruised to a 3-0 win over Austrian side Sturm Graz.

articles.headline: Bournemouth beat Sturm Graz for dream European home debut
articles.description: Bournemouth won their first European match at the Vitality Stadium as Sturm Graz were beaten 3-0 to maintain Marco Rose's perfect start in the Europa League.

images.credit: Robin Jones/AFC Bournemouth via Getty Images

articles.headline: 'Frustrated' Pierre Sage: Crystal Palace 'really far off' expectations in Lyon defeat

images.caption: Pierre Sage was left frustrated by his team's poor performance in the first half.

articles.headline: Milan's Cissè becomes Italy's youngest European hat-trick scorer
articles.description: Alphadjo Cissè made European history for Italy with his hat trick in AC Milan 's 4-0 thrashing of RB Salzburg in the UEFA Europa League on Thursday.

articles.headline: Cissè hat trick leads Milan to rout of Salzburg
articles.description: Alphadjo Cissè scored a hat trick as AC Milan got their Europa League campaign up and running with a 4-0 win at RB Salzburg, who slipped to a first defeat of the season.
